newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares firm on fresh EU accord optimism.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares firm on fresh EU accord optimism.

text.p: Slovenian shares closed higher on Thursday, fuelled by expectations the EU association treaty would be ratified, which in turn could bring foreign capital back to the market, traders said.

"If the Constitutional Court says the ratification is in line with the constitution, the index may rise by about five percent in a week. If not, prices could fall by up to 50 percent short-term," said Andrej Obed, a trader at A bank.
* The SBI index rose 0.59 percent or 7.79 points to 1,323.34.
* Food maker Kolinska was the most active share, easing 0.10 percent to 1,903 on volume of 9,803 shares. -- Ljubljna newsroom, 386-61-125-8439.
